name: AI Applyd
tagline: Find matched jobs and apply on the employer's own hiring system, with a resume tailored to each role
description: Hosted MCP server for job seekers. Find jobs matched to your resume, score your resume against a posting, tailor the resume and cover letter for each role, and apply on the employer's own hiring system across 34 hiring systems, including Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and iCIMS. Send each application automatically or hold it for your approval, track which employers confirmed receipt, and prepare for interviews. 17 tools. Sign in once with OAuth; no API key.
